name: devpod
description: Open-source dev containers orchestrator that spins up reproducible dev environments on any machine or cloud via providers

install_steps: curl -L -o devpod https://github.com/loft-sh/devpod/releases/latest/download/devpod-linux-amd64 && sudo install -o root -g root -m 0755 devpod /usr/local/bin

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install devpod: download binary from https://github.com/loft-sh/devpod/releases or brew install devpod
